title: Palestinian Commission Documents 62,916 Settler Attacks in West Bank
detail: The Palestinian commission releases data clarifying 62,916 settler attacks against Palestinians in the West Bank, providing a documented scale of the ongoing pattern of settler violence. The data offers a statistical baseline for the severity of attacks targeting Palestinian communities and agricultural lands.

sources.name: Palestinian Commission for Detainees and Ex-Detainees Affairs

title: Israeli Opposition Leader Proposes Joint Jordanian-Israeli Control Over West Bank
detail: An Israeli opposition leader proposed a plan for joint Jordanian-Israeli governance over the West Bank, intensifying debate on the territory's future political status. The proposal marks a significant shift in opposition discourse on territorial governance and reignites discussions about a possible Jordanian role in Palestinian affairs, which Jordan has historically distanced itself from.

media.caption: Israeli opposition leader proposes joint Jordanian-Israeli governance of West Bank

title: Settlers Burn Olive Trees, Detain Journalists During West Bank Harvest Season
detail: Israeli settlers burned olive trees and attacked Palestinian farmers during the annual olive harvest season in the West Bank. Journalists covering the incidents were detained by Israeli forces. The attacks continued a pattern of settler violence that intensifies each October during the harvest, disrupting one of Palestinians' most economically significant agricultural seasons.
